REFERENCE PRIORITY: image 4 (the accepted T01 asset) defines the exact family DNA, FRONT and shape language. Image 5, when supplied, is the accepted immediate predecessor. Images 1-3 are MATERIAL/PALETTE inspiration only; NEVER copy their whole buildings, props, layout or lighting. Render exactly the current tier described below, not the style-reference scene. Never add boxes, crates, loose props or extra symbols. All lamps OFF, all glass non-emissive, no glow. Thick rounded clean forms, broad painted color areas.

TARGETED T14: Preserve accepted T13 image 5 and add ONE tall round FILTER TOWER integrated behind the rear reactor platform, visibly rising above the paired domes. Distinguish this new filter tower from the existing THREE smooth right-side tank cylinders: use a broad sage cylinder with three thick stacked rounded filter collars, dark recessed vent bands and a rounded cap, all solid and connected into the building. No smoke, thin fins or antennae. Keep the two domes, strong overhead brass bridge, two-storey leaf-gabled front, solar slope, ground canopy, rear-right automated hall and forward sealed output unchanged. The new round filter tower is the only major new volume; preserve compact base footprint and front.

CRITICAL FRAMING: Zoom OUT substantially. The complete building including the NEW FILTER TOWER may occupy at most 78 percent of image HEIGHT and 78 percent of WIDTH. Leave at least 11 percent totally blank warm-gray background above the tower cap and below the lowest foundation and at both sides. Center the bounding box of the whole tall object; do not center only its lower hall. No extremity may approach the image edges. This is a square studio catalog image of the entire tall building, not a close-up.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one final Meshy image-to-3D building reference for Weedtopia Inc / Burning Hills.
Subject: harvest refinement building, T14_L800. Exact visible state: tall rounded filter tower.
Family DNA: soft gabled hall, rounded refinement tank on local +X, broad harvest portal. Function: harvest refinement building.
Progression: Preserve the T01 family DNA and the previously accepted tier. Integrate previous functional capacity compactly upward and rearward, inside the reserved parcel. Current cumulative architectural milestones: one repaired hall with one round refinement tank; second large refinement tank; wide roofed harvest intake portal; rear workshop wing; permanent plaster side hall; third tall refinement tank; wide enclosed output wing; solar roof across refinement hall; large enamel refinement dome; second refinement dome on shared foundation; thick integrated pipe bridge; two-storey processing hall; rear automated hall section; tall rounded filter tower. No separate freestanding buildings: all wings and modules are structurally attached.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 18m local X by 16m local Z, maximum family height 28m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: warm plaster, sage enamel, aged corrugated metal, brass; epoch treatment: matte concrete, olive enamel, larger integrated service modules. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
review_notes: Visually accepted corrected T14: tall new rear round filter tower with thick stacked collars and dark vent bands is clearly distinct from three retained smooth tank cylinders. Entire tower cap now separated from top edge with clear blank margin, all foundations visible. Prior two domes/brass bridge, two-storey solar gable, canopy and halls/output retained. Neutral isolated studio, no smoke scene people props text or glow.
